opening.argument: The presentation directly links opening a free MTI account with earning bitcoin and says participation can provide passive crypto income without previous blockchain experience or advanced technical expertise. It further presents MTI as a way to invest in bitcoin without putting in the time and effort, leaving the activity to professionals. The MTI branding, sponsored closing screen, sign-up links, membership-scale claim, and positive testimonials reinforce that promotional invitation. The material does not establish actual earnings, account conditions, required funding, or what happens after sign-up, so the observable case rests on the promise and solicitation of investment-related returns rather than demonstrated results.
